light.line: Preschoolers stole the show at the groundbreaking for Camdenton's new Early Childhood Center on a cloudy Tuesday. Tiny shovels, big smiles.
Chick-fil-A opens in Osage Beach on Thursday, Nov. 5, with a free entree for customers dressed in cow-themed attire. Time to dig out the cow costume.
Marshfield residents came close to their donation goal at the community blood drive at the Marshfield Senior Center in October. Every pint pitches in.
Camdenton's football program is a generational community, with the same families returning to play on the same field. Like father, like Laker.
